Telemetry: append-heavy, ~50 GB/month growth, no cross-db dependency

  partition by date  -> hot recent range stays fast to query
  compress old ranges -> large storage/IO cut, small CPU cost

Do it now, while it's manageable — not after it's 10x the size.
